name: Spectral data mask
doc: Uses a live audio data generator (spectrogram or piano-roll) as an animated mask over the input media, revealing the picture through spectral peaks while turning quiet areas into edge-lit blueprints with onset RGB and block corruption.

data.doc: audio visualization mask (e.g. agy-spectrogram.out or agy-pianoroll.out)

edges.doc: media edge gradient (e.g. core-media.edges) for wireframe blueprint in unmasked regions

palette.doc: tint for blueprint edges and spectral rim glow

threshold.doc: data brightness threshold that opens the mask window

soft.doc: feather width of the spectral mask

ghost.doc: base visibility of the picture in quiet unmasked regions

data_glow.doc: spectral/piano-roll rim glow blended around the mask

edge_glow.doc: neon contour wireframe strength in unmasked areas

rgb_split.doc: chromatic RGB channel split on spectral peaks and onsets

block_glitch.doc: macroblock displacement across the mask on onsets
